import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(limits=4)

heads = {}
for l in range(12):
    A = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.qkv.W"], dtype=np.float64)
    g = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"], dtype=np.float64)
    b = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.shift"], dtype=np.float64)
    B = g[:, None] * A
    B -= B.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    bias = b @ A + np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.qkv.b"], dtype=np.float64)
    for h in range(12):
        Q = B[:, 64*h:64*(h+1)]
        K = B[:, 768+64*h:768+64*(h+1)]
        r = K @ bias[64*h:64*(h+1)] / 8
        norm = np.sqrt(np.sum((Q.T @ Q)*(K.T @ K))) / 8
        heads[f"{l}.{h}"] = (Q, K, r, norm)

selected = [
    "0.11", "1.0", "1.3", "1.4", "1.5", "1.7", "1.8", "1.11",
    "2.0", "2.2", "2.3", "2.4", "2.5", "2.6", "2.7", "2.8",
    "2.10", "2.11", "4.9", "8.2", "9.3", "9.8", "10.8", "10.11"
]
matrices = []
svds = {}
print("Leading singular values of QK products:")
for name in selected:
    Q, K, r, norm = heads[name]
    uq, rq = np.linalg.qr(Q, mode="reduced")
    uk, rk = np.linalg.qr(K, mode="reduced")
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(rq @ rk.T / 8, full_matrices=False)
    U, V = uq @ u, uk @ vt.T
    svds[name] = (U, s, V)
    matrices.append((Q @ K.T / 8).ravel())
    print(name, np.round(s[:8], 4), "bias norm", round(np.linalg.norm(r), 4))

M = np.stack(matrices)
cos = (M @ M.T) / (np.linalg.norm(M, axis=1)[:, None]
                       * np.linalg.norm(M, axis=1)[None, :])
pairs = []
for i in range(len(selected)):
    for j in range(i):
        pairs.append((selected[j], selected[i], cos[i,j]))
print("\nLargest absolute pairwise QK-product correlations:")
for a, b, c in sorted(pairs, key=lambda t: -abs(t[2]))[:50]:
    print(a, b, round(c, 4))

core = ["2.3", "2.4", "2.5", "2.10", "2.11"]
columns = []
for name in core:
    U, s, V = svds[name]
    columns.extend([U[:, :4], V[:, :4]])
basis, sshared, _ = np.linalg.svd(np.concatenate(columns, axis=1), full_matrices=False)
print("\nSingular values defining shared layer-2 subspace:")
print(np.round(sshared[:20], 4))
S = basis[:, :6]

rows = []
reference = heads["2.4"]
for name, (Q, K, r, norm) in heads.items():
    m = (S.T @ Q) @ (S.T @ K).T / 8
    total_trace = np.sum(Q*K)/8
    refcos = np.sum((Q.T @ reference[0])*(K.T @ reference[1])) / (
        64*norm*reference[3])
    rows.append(dict(head=name, strength=norm,
                     shared_fraction=np.linalg.norm(m)**2/norm**2,
                     shared_bias=np.linalg.norm(S.T @ r)/(np.linalg.norm(r)+1e-20),
                     outside_trace=total_trace-np.trace(m),
                     cos_2_4=refcos))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nHeads most concentrated in the shared six-dimensional subspace:")
print(df.nlargest(35, "shared_fraction").to_string(index=False,
      float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.4f}"))

print("\nProjected weight products and bias vectors in that common basis:")
for name in ["1.0", "1.3", "1.5", "1.11", "2.3", "2.4", "2.5",
             "2.7", "2.10", "2.11", "9.8", "10.8", "10.11"]:
    Q, K, r, norm = heads[name]
    print(name)
    print(np.round((S.T @ Q) @ (S.T @ K).T / 8, 3))
    print("bias:", np.round(S.T @ r, 3))
